items.description: A Marshall-style all-tube 18-watt amp head with two channels, built from a Mojotone 18 Watt TMB kit in a 19.75" head cabinet I made for it. Channel one is the classic 18-watt circuit with big JTM 45-like tones. Channel two uses a JCM 800 preamp with Treble, Mid, Bass and Master Volume controls. Cathode-biased, two EL84s, EZ81 rectifier. It is loud.
items.note: Amp head only. The speaker cabinet in some photos is not included.

items.description: A hand-carved A-style mandolin from Flatiron's Bozeman, Montana shop, made in 1994 and signed on the label by Bruce D. Weber. Gibson bought Flatiron in 1987 and kept the Bozeman luthiers building Gibson and Flatiron mandolins there until 1996, when production moved to Nashville. Weber ran that shop and went on to found Weber Fine Acoustic Instruments. The Artist was the top of Flatiron's A-model line: carved spruce top, flamed maple back and sides, bound ebony fingerboard, gold hardware and the pearl-inlaid "The Flatiron" headstock. Bozeman-era Flatirons are well regarded for their tone and are often compared to Gibson A-5s from the same shop. It has a K&K Mandolin Twin pickup installed, so it plugs straight into an amp or PA through the 1/4" endpin jack, and it comes in its original hard-shell case.
